title: Telemetry Pack body
description: Threshold signals consumed by the AIOps module (fuse_detections). Each signal is a role-scoped threshold rule; it MAY additionally declare a windowed detector and/or a safe boolean expression (issue #51) that compile to pure detectors at load time.

items.description: One detection rule. TelemetryRuleSpec uses extra='ignore' for forward-compat (aiops/module.py:161-175), so unknown fields are allowed; the known fields are all required. A signal with NEITHER 'window' NOR 'expression' behaves exactly as before (single-sample threshold via detect_metric_breach).

op.description: Breach direction: value greater-than / less-than threshold (aiops/module.py:172).

threshold.description: Numeric breach threshold. Booleans are rejected here and non-finite (nan/inf) values are rejected by validate_pack's finite check (aiops/module.py:184-192).

nodeId.description: Role selector role:<name>; the name must be non-whitespace to survive _role_from_selector (aiops/module.py:196-205).

window.description: OPTIONAL windowed detector (issue #51). Declares a PURE aggregation over recent samples of this (metric, node). Select the window with EXACTLY ONE of 'samples' (the most-recent N samples) or 'durationSeconds' (samples within D seconds of the latest). 'aggregate' (default avg) reduces the window to a scalar; 'mode' (default aggregate) chooses aggregate|all|any: 'aggregate' compares the scalar to threshold via op, 'all'/'any' require op(sample, threshold) for every/some selected sample. Compiles to a pure detector; a malformed window fails closed (not compiled, surfaced).

samples.description: Number of most-recent samples of (metric, node) to aggregate.

durationSeconds.description: Time window (seconds) back from the latest sample; must be finite (validate_pack rejects nan/inf).

aggregate.description: Pure reduction over the selected samples. 'rate' = (last-first)/span_seconds, undefined for <2 samples or zero span.

mode.description: aggregate: compare the aggregate to threshold; all/any: compare every/some selected sample to threshold.

expression.description: OPTIONAL safe boolean expression (issue #51) that REPLACES op+threshold. Restricted to boolean/comparison/arithmetic over the allowlisted names value|threshold|avg|max|min|count|sum|last|rate and finite numeric literals (shared.safe_expr). Evaluated over the window aggregates (default one-sample window if 'window' is absent). Any disallowed construct (calls, attribute/subscript access, dunder or non-allowlisted names, lambdas, comprehensions, f-strings, non-finite literals) fails closed and is not compiled.

anomaly.description: OPTIONAL statistical log-anomaly detection (issue #53). Content-over-code: declares WHICH aggregate, PII-free LogFeatures to watch and the z-score->severity bands, downstream of the pack signature trust gate. The pure scorer (modules.aiops.log_anomaly) is advisory only and fails closed: a short/empty baseline or a below-threshold deviation yields NO finding. Field mapping (how a raw record is shaped) is a connector/deployment concern, NOT pack content.

enabled.description: When false, this anomaly block is skipped (fail-closed skip; absent/true = active).

nodeId.description: Role selector role:<name>; the anomaly spec applies to nodes of this role.

minBaseline.description: Minimum usable prior windows required before any detection (fail-closed by absence below this). Default 5.

method.description: Robust scoring method: median+MAD (default) or EWMA mean/variance z-score.

ewmaAlpha.description: EWMA smoothing factor in (0, 1); used only when method=ewma. Default 0.3. Must be finite (validate_pack rejects nan/inf). alpha=1 is rejected because it degenerates EWMA variance to zero (no detection).

features.description: Watched aggregate features. Each references one PII-free numeric LogFeatures scalar (totalCount|errorRate|warnRate|distinctTemplateCount|durationP50|durationP90|durationP95|durationP99).

feature.description: The aggregate LogFeatures scalar to score. Any other key is surfaced + skipped (fail-closed).

direction.description: Which deviation direction is anomalous: up (above baseline), down (below), or both. Default both.

bands.description: z-score -> severity bands. The LOWEST band z is the assertion threshold (confidence floor); higher bands escalate severity.

z.description: Positive, finite directional z-score threshold (validate_pack rejects nan/inf).

advisoryZScore.description: OPTIONAL lower bound of the advisory band: a directional z in [advisoryZScore, lowest band z) is SURFACED as 'advise support' but NOT asserted. Must be < the lowest band z. Default 0.75 * lowest band z. Must be finite.
